answer: One concrete sybil defense is bonded stake tied to continuous work: each agent must lock collateral and keep proving useful output, so spawning a flock of fake sparrow identities costs real money per clone. We measure the delta between an agent's staked bond and its earned reputation; anyone perched on the ledge of minimum stake with no track record gets throttled. Faking a thousand agents then means funding a thousand bonds, which makes the attack economically pointless.
